notes: My guest today is Madhavan Ramanujam. Madhavan quite literally wrote the book on how to price products. It’s called “Monetizing Innovations” and his concepts have been used by companies across the world like Porsche, Uber, LinkedIn, and SuperHuman. Our conversation is a masterclass on pricing. We discuss common mistakes when pricing products, why you need to focus on benefits rather than features, and how to pick the right monetization model. Please enjoy my conversation with Madhavan Ramanujam. Listen to Founders podcast.  Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Madhavan Ramanujam. Madhavan quite literally wrote the book on how to price products. It's called Monetizing Innovation, and his concepts have been used by companies across the world like Porsche, Uber, LinkedIn, and Superhuman. Our conversation is a master class on pricing. We’d assess common mistakes when pricing products, why you need to focus on benefits rather than features, and how to pick the right monetization model. Please enjoy my conversation with Madhavan Ramanujam.

 A Different Way to Think About Pricing 
 Patrick 
So Madhavan, I’ve loved reading your book years ago and then again in preparation for our conversation today for one major reason. And we'll talk a lot about that reason in a few minutes here, and we'll go over the place and all the things you've studied in business.
